note: Sweden fiscal authority paths. NBR annuals and borrowing plan from Riksgälden Statsupplåning. Monthly CH1089 splits primary / net lending / interest. Live cash = Riksgälden annual NBR × PRE seasonal month shape. v2 macro bottom-up: Budgetprop + KI + Statskontoret annuals, SCB categories × macro / CAT_SEAS month shape; RG pin only after category sum. SHIP=False (anchored PRE).

nbr_annual_balance.source: Riksgälden Statsupplåning – prognos och analys (Tabell 3 budget balance = −NBR)
nbr_annual_balance.unit: SEK bn, calendar year (positive = surplus / negative = deficit)

nbr_components.unit: SEK mn monthly, NBR sign (+ = borrowing)

budgetprop.source: 2026 års ekonomiska vårproposition (Spring Fiscal Policy Bill) — Statens budget i siffror / regeringen.se

2025.note: 2025 labelled outturn in spring bill tables

budgetprop.primary_spend_bn_note: Utgifter exkl. statsskuldsräntor (incl. anslagsbehållningar). Maps to SCB exp − CH1089 interest.

macro_determinants.source: same bill / Finance Ministry forecast assumptions (hand summary)
macro_determinants.note: Category elasticities fitted on Eurostat NGDP / HICP / D1 wages and debt-book effective rates; bill does not publish a ready-reckoner matrix.

ki.source: Konjunkturinstitutet Prognosdatabasen — F3328 Statens budgetsaldo; F3304 Statens finanser (NR perimeter)
ki.note: F3328Lbsminus = cash budgetsaldo (comparable to −NBR). F3304 tax/interest are national-accounts state finances, not Budgetprop cash lines — used as cross-check / macro context only. KI 2026 saldo (−140) sits between Budgetprop (−184) and Riksgälden (−196).

statskontoret.source: Statskontoret Prognos för statens budget och de offentliga finanserna
statskontoret.note: Broader / more negative 2026 saldo than Budgetprop and KI; not used as the live RG pin.
